title: Servlet context init parameters (Tomcat context.xml Parameter) not visible in Environment for a WAR on Spring Boot 4.0.0: 'Could not resolve placeholder'

sources.license: Facts summarized from a public GitHub issue/PR; short error excerpt quoted.

symptom: A SpringBootServletInitializer-based WAR on an external Tomcat no longer sees properties supplied as servlet context init parameters (context.xml <Parameter>); bean creation fails with PlaceholderResolutionException: Could not resolve placeholder 'storage.root'. spring.datasource.* values supplied that way are ignored too.
cause: WarDeploymentApplicationContextFactory does not implement getEnvironmentType() in 4.0.0, so SpringApplication falls back to the default servlet factory from the spring-boot-web-server module. With the embedded Tomcat starter excluded or provided that module is not on the classpath, the environment is converted to a plain non-servlet ApplicationEnvironment, and the servletContextInitParams property source stays an unpopulated stub.
fixSummary: In ServletInitializer.configure, set the environment explicitly: builder.sources(Application::class.java).environment(StandardServletEnvironment()) (org.springframework.web.context.support.StandardServletEnvironment). Putting spring-boot-web-server on the classpath also works but adds the module to the WAR. Fixed upstream in 4.0.1.
